offering_description.value: Issues fixed indexed annuities, registered index-linked annuities, multi-year guaranteed annuities and indexed universal life insurance to individuals seeking retirement savings and income. Also provides pension risk transfer and funding agreements to institutions. Sells mainly through independent agents, banks and broker-dealers.

primary_products.value: fixed indexed annuities; registered index-linked annuities; multi-year guaranteed annuities; indexed universal life insurance; funding agreements

customer_segment.value: B2C: individuals saving for retirement and seeking income or life insurance protection; B2B: corporate pension plan sponsors, institutional investors and funding agreement buyers

end_markets.value: retirement savings; life insurance; institutional pension and investment markets

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: premiums and deposits on annuities and life insurance, plus investment spread income; service fees: policy and rider fees, cost of insurance charges

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes in premiums and deposits, invests in fixed income and other assets, pays guaranteed benefits to policyholders

geography_served.value: US national: Sells in most US states through independent distribution

specialization.value: related lines: annuities, life insurance and institutional spread products

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent marketing organizations and independent agents; partners / resellers: banks and broker-dealers; direct sales: institutional sales of pension risk transfer and funding agreements
distribution_channels.category: agents / brokers; partners / resellers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance carrier regulated by state insurance departments, NAIC rules, SEC for registered products, and DOL fiduciary rules
